text: AewolFlow: AI literature reviews with evidence you can inspect
It seems everyone is a founder (myself as well), and everyone has his or her business and also use AI to build products, and rely on AI for everything. AI changed everything.

I named the company after Aewol, a quiet coastal town on Jeju. Research life felt like scattered notes across tabs and half-read PDFs. I wanted a place you could actually return to. That’s why we built AewolFlow.
